newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD bid specs may be out Wed.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD bid specs may be out Wed.

text.p: Brazilian Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said tender documents for the sell-off of state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) may be released to the public as early as Wednesday.
Kandir, speaking at the American Chamber of Commerce, said he would likely receive by Tuesday a proposal for Vale's tender documents from the National Development Bank (BNDES).
He added that he planned to submit the proposal to the National Privatization Council when it meets on Wednesday.
"I will review the tender documents tomorrow and submit them on Wednesday. If the discussion develops well, we may release them immediately," Kandir said.
The Privatization Council was expected to discuss CVRD's minimum price and auction date for the block sale of a 40-45 percent voting stake in the company.
If the government releases the tender documents on Wednesday, they can be published in the official gazette on Thursday, Kandir said.
The government hopes to raise $10 billion in privatization revenues in 1997, about half of that from the Vale sale.
